2608.14132.title: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions
2608.14132.paper_summary: Mobile GUI Agents powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise in human-computer intelligence. However, current research primarily focuses on reactive task execution while lacking a comprehensive understanding-prediction-execution process for user intentions, which are the core requirements of active agents. In this paper, we propose the Act2Intention framework that builds an active mobile agent by integrating understanding, predicting user intentions, and executing decisions. First, we construct the Act2Intention Bench through data collection and validated generation, comprising 72,511 intentions and over 700,000 actions across 52 apps, thereby establishing the first benchmark for evaluating proactive agents via continuous intention-action trajectories. We further develop the Act2Intention Agent, achieving proactive services through Proactive-oriented Intention Understanding, Personalized Proactive Intention Prediction, and Experience-guided Intention Execution. Experimental results show that supervised fine-tuning on Act2Intention Bench yields absolute improvements of +32.0 Acc-S, +10.25 Acc-S, and +6.9 SSR points over non-fine-tuned counterparts under the same agent framework for intention understanding, prediction, and execution, respectively. This success underscores the necessity and value of the Act2Intention Bench, which establishes a standardized platform for developing and evaluating proactive agents and consequently paves the way for research on intention-driven human-computer interaction.
2608.14132.paper_summary_zh: 行動圖形用戶界面代理由多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）驅動，在人機智能方面顯示出潛力。<lb/>然而，目前的研究主要集中在反應性任務執行上，缺乏對用戶意圖的全面理解-預測-執行過程，這是主動代理的核心需求。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了 Act2Intention 框架，通過整合理解、預測用戶意圖和執行決策來構建一個主動的行動代理。<lb/>首先，我們通過數據收集和驗證生成構建了 Act2Intention Bench，該基準包含 72,511 個意圖和超過 700,000 個行動，涵蓋 52 個應用程序，從而建立了評估主動代理的第一個基準，通過持續的意圖-行動軌跡。<lb/>我們進一步開發了 Act2Intention Agent，通過以主動為導向的意圖理解、個性化主動意圖預測和經驗引導的意圖執行來實現主動服務。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，在 Act2Intention Bench 上進行監督性微調，相比於在相同代理框架下未經微調的對應模型，在意圖理解、預測和執行方面分別實現了 +32.0 Acc-S、+10.25 Acc-S 和 +6.9 SSR 點的絕對提升。<lb/>這一成功強調了 Act2Intention Bench 的必要性和價值，該基準建立了一個標準化的平台，用於開發和評估主動代理，從而為基於意圖的人機互動研究鋪平了道路。
